title: Assembly Examples
description: Each example belongs to one starter lesson. Follow its setup steps before trying it. These examples need the named tools and do not run in this site playground.

examples.title: Return a small result
examples.description: rdi is a register: a tiny storage place in the processor. Linux exit reads its status from rdi.
examples.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rdi, 5
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

examples.title: Copy a register value
examples.description: mov copies a value. It does not erase the source register.
examples.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rbx, 3
    mov rdi, rbx
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

examples.title: Add two numbers
examples.description: add changes its first register by adding the second value.
examples.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rdi, 3
    add rdi, 2
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

examples.title: Subtract a number
examples.description: sub subtracts the second value from the first register.
examples.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rdi, 8
    sub rdi, 3
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

examples.title: Multiply a value
examples.description: imul multiplies signed integers. This form stores the result in its first register.
examples.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rdi, 3
    imul rdi, rdi, 2
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

examples.title: Divide a whole number
examples.description: div divides rdx:rax by its input. For this small positive example, clear rdx first.
examples.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 8
    xor rdx, rdx
    mov rbx, 3
    div rbx
    mov rdi, rax
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

examples.title: Keep chosen bits
examples.description: and keeps only bits that are 1 in both inputs. A final bit of 1 marks an odd number.
examples.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rdi, 5
    and rdi, 1
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

examples.title: Choose a path
examples.description: cmp compares values and sets flags. je jumps when the compared values are equal.
examples.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rdi, 0
    mov rbx, 5
    cmp rbx, 5
    je .same
    jmp .done
.same:
    mov rdi, 1
.done:
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

examples.title: Repeat with a counter
examples.description: A label names a place in the code. jnz repeats while the last result was not zero.
examples.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rcx, 3
    mov rdi, 0
.again:
    add rdi, 2
    dec rcx
    jnz .again
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

examples.title: Save and restore a value
examples.description: push places a value on the stack. pop takes the most recent value back.
examples.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    push 7
    pop rdi
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

examples.title: Call a small routine
examples.description: call saves a return address and jumps. ret returns to the instruction after call.
examples.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rdi, 4
    call twice
    mov rax, 60
    syscall
twice:
    add rdi, rdi
    ret

examples.title: Ask Linux to write text
examples.description: The write system call uses rax=1, rdi=1 for standard output, an address in rsi and a length in rdx.
examples.code:
global _start
section .data
message: db "Hi", 10
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    lea rsi, [rel message]
    mov rdx, 3
    syscall
    mov rdi, 0
    mov rax, 60
    syscall
